segments.script: [EN: Warm up.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Busy.] [PAUSE 3s] [VI: Bận.] [EN: To postpone, move.] [PAUSE 3s] [VI: Dời.] [EN: Late.] [PAUSE 3s] [VI: Trễ.] [EN: Plastic bag.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Túi ni lông.] [EN: Good.]

[EN: A station is] [VI_F: Ga.] [EN: a flat tone. The train station is] [VI: ga xe lửa.] [EN: A ticket is] [VI_F: Vé.] [EN: a high, rising tone. To buy is] [VI: mua.] [EN: I want to buy a ticket.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Tôi muốn mua vé.] [EN: Good.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: A scheduled trip or departure is] [VI_F: Chuyến.] [EN: a high, rising tone. To ask which departure, say] [VI: chuyến nào.] [EN: The next trip.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Chuyến sau.] [EN: I want a ticket for the next trip.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Tôi muốn mua vé chuyến sau.] [EN: Good.]

[EN: Drill. Station.] [PAUSE 3s] [VI: Ga.] [EN: Ticket.] [PAUSE 3s] [VI: Vé.] [EN: Trip, departure.] [PAUSE 3s] [VI: Chuyến.] [EN: I want to buy a ticket.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Tôi muốn mua vé.] [EN: A ticket for the next trip.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Vé chuyến sau.] [EN: Now reverse.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: What does this mean?] [VI_F: Vé.] [PAUSE 3s] [EN: Ticket.] [EN: What does this mean?] [VI_F: Chuyến.] [PAUSE 3s] [EN: Trip, departure.] [EN: Good.]

[EN: Listen at the station.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI_M: Chị ơi, cho tôi mua vé đi Đà Lạt.] [VI_F: Dạ, chuyến mấy giờ anh?] [VI_M: Chuyến sau. Bao nhiêu vậy?] [VI_F: Dạ, hai trăm ngàn.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Now you try. Say I want to buy a ticket.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Tôi muốn mua vé.] [EN: Say, the next trip.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Chuyến sau.] [EN: Good.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Tomorrow you describe a normal day. The preview word is] [VI: bình thường] [EN: which means usual, normal.]
